deviations.what: float32 stage B thresholds for 50 guided steps differ from report 09's (derived for 10 PiFlow steps): rel_l2 <= 3.8e-6 over the first 10 steps (10x the worst 3.8e-7), frames >= 43.5 dB and audio >= 24.6 dB (worst minus 20 dB), instead of rel_l2 <= 7.2e-4 at every step, 76 dB and 64 dB
deviations.why: with guidance 5 over 50 steps any rounding difference grows about 1.3-1.5x per step: MLX vs torch reaches rel_l2 2.3e-3 at step 49 (seed 42), and two float32 runs of torch itself (CPU vs MPS) reach 1.9e-3, frames 64.7 dB and audio 38.0 dB apart. MLX is within 1.2-2x of that torch-vs-torch floor at every step and at the floor in frames (63.5 dB) and above it in audio (44.6 dB). The early-step bound keeps the per-step port check tight; the final bounds follow report 09's method on two seeds.

deviations.what: bf16: the spec 09 stop condition (per-step cosine >= 0.99) is replaced by 'not below torch bf16's own minimum cosine'
deviations.why: torch bf16 itself drops to cosine 0.9748 (seed 42) and 0.9884 (seed 1) over the 50 guided steps; MLX stays above it (0.9822, 0.9894), within 1.05x of torch's drift at every step, and its frames are closer to float32 than torch's (28.2 vs 23.9 dB, 27.6 vs 27.3 dB).

deviations.what: public API: guidance_scale > 1 no longer raises NotImplementedError; it requires negative_text_embeds. num_inference_steps and guidance_scale default to None and are resolved from the checkpoint's scheduler (PiFlow: 10 and 1; FlowMatch: 50 and 5)
deviations.why: spec 13 adds guidance; tests/e2e/test_pipeline_tiny.py was updated accordingly

deviations.what: batched CFG pads the shorter text to a common length with a padding mask
deviations.why: diffusers runs cond and uncond as two calls with different text lengths; batching them needs padding. The masked keys get zero weight, so the result equals sequential mode (rel_max <= 1e-5 on the tiny model).

architecture_notes.note: Smoke with Lite-5s (50 steps x 2 DiT calls) denoises in 132 s (bf16) vs 13.4 s for Lite-distill: about 10x, 1.32 s per DiT call, the same as the distilled model per call. Peak memory is unchanged (8.1 GB) in sequential CFG.
architecture_notes.optimization: Batched CFG (B=2) may use the GPU better at Smoke size; step skipping (MagCache) and distillation are the bigger levers.

architecture_notes.note: Over 50 steps with guidance 5, float32 differences grow from 4e-8 to 2e-3 (latent rel_l2), the same for torch CPU vs torch MPS as for MLX vs torch; in bf16 the minimum step cosine falls to 0.975-0.99 for both. Parity of long guided samplers must be judged against cross-implementation floors, not fixed thresholds.
architecture_notes.optimization: Keep the scheduler arithmetic in float32 where the reference does; nothing to gain by tighter kernels.

architecture_notes.note: Lite-5s's DiT outputs velocity (out dims 16/40) where Lite-distill outputs PiFlow mixtures (160/400); it stores 691 F32 tensors (423 in Lite-distill), 6.96 GiB; the media components are byte-identical except the audio VAE scaling_factor (0.5302 vs 0.417).
architecture_notes.optimization: Share VAE, audio VAE weights and vocoder between installs (done with links).
